title: Higher-order thalamus and neuromodulators control dendritic coupling

statements.text: Suppressing higher-order thalamus decouples the apical from the basal compartment, and neuromodulatory state controls the coupling. The coupling depends on metabotropic receptors, a receptor type not usually modeled in artificial neural networks.

sources.quote: Suppressing higher-order thalamus decouples apical from basal dendritic compartments.
Neuromodulatory state controls dendritic coupling in L5 pyramidal neurons.
This dendritic coupling was demonstrated to be controlled by metabotropic receptors
